input_fields.name: loaded_script_identity
input_fields.description: Exact loaded script identity, hash, session, and document binding.

input_fields.name: current_design_identity
input_fields.description: Active design identity and clean/baseline-copy entry state.

result_fields.name: execution_event
result_fields.description: One run identifier, launch time, script hash, session/document identity, and command observation.

result_fields.name: launch_status
result_fields.description: One of launched, rejected, or needs_manual_review; not a completion result.

procedure: Recheck loaded hash, active design identity, authorization, and idle state.
Issue one Run command and record the run identifier and launch observation.
Return execution_event with launch_status=launched; hand completion to EX-10.
If the command or identity cannot be confirmed, return needs_manual_review and do not press Run again.
rejection_rules: Reject script/document/session mismatch, expired authorization, busy/modal state, or an already-running event.
Reject duplicate or uncertain launch events.
Do not equate button activation or a UI pause with completion.
